case: MySQL app temporal grid edit and CSV/JSON/XLSX export plus CSV import instant round trip
contract: The app parser maps TIME(6) input to Value::Time and DATETIME(6)/TIMESTAMP(6) grid-edit input to Value::DateTime.
The app keyed-update builder persists all three temporal values; native reads verify exact values, cast text, microseconds, UTC TIMESTAMP epoch, and an unchanged sibling row.
A native MySQL query result exports exact fractional TIME/DATETIME text and UTC RFC3339 TIMESTAMP text through CSV and JSON.
The CSV import plan restores timestamp(6) RFC3339 text as Value::TimestampTz for MySQL and the resulting bound inserts read back equal to the exported native rows.
Driver-aware MySQL timestamp parsing leaves generic and PostgreSQL timestamp-without-time-zone parsing as Value::DateTime.
The real XLSX result workbook contains the fractional TIME/DATETIME and UTC RFC3339 TIMESTAMP strings as text cells.

focused_docker.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-app value_contract_mysql_temporal_parser_keyed_edit_preserves_native_values_and_siblings -- --include-ignored --test-threads=1

app_parser_grid_and_round_trip.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-app mysql_temporal_contract:: -- --include-ignored --test-threads=1

core_importer.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-core mysql_timestamp_csv_import_restores_the_utc_instant

clippy.command: rtk proxy cargo clippy --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-core -p tablepro-app --all-targets -- -D warnings

core_import_suite.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-core import::
